prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: design approval image for Rakky Ride mobile app Settings; two related screens shown side by side.
Primary request: redesign the existing settings page into a beautiful, compact, white-forward ride-hailing app interface. Small readable typography, concise words, conventional line icons, restrained green accents. Show the main Settings screen on the left and its Notifications detail screen on the right.
Composition: flat high-fidelity UI design board on a very pale silver background, two complete tall mobile screens with thin rounded outlines, same size, comfortably separated, no tilted phones or device hardware. Roughly 390 by 844 logical pixels per screen, rendered sharply. Each screen white, compact header and generous but efficient spacing. Make all text readable. No giant heading, no hero illustration. 15px page titles, 13px body, 11–12px helper copy, 16–18px icons, minimum 44px touch rows. Fine separators, 12px card corners, subtle mint icon backgrounds.
Palette: forest green #176B17 for selected controls, charcoal #141A14 text, muted #586253, white #FFFFFF, silver #EEF1EC, pale mint #EAF5E5, subdued red only for Log out.
LEFT screen:
small status bar 9:41 then back arrow and "Settings".
Compact caption below: "Make Rakky Ride yours."
Section label "APPEARANCE". A neat card with three equal segmented options, each a small sun, moon or device line icon, labels "Light", "Dark", "System". Light selected with pale green fill and green outline.
Section label "PREFERENCES".
White bordered group, rows with small conventional icon at left, label and short secondary text, chevron at right:
1. bell icon "Notifications" / "Choose what you receive"
2. location pin icon "Location permissions" / "Manage in device settings"
3. history clock icon "Notification history" / "View your updates"
Section label "PRIVACY".
Single muted row shield icon "Privacy and data" and a small neutral "Coming soon" badge; not a chevron and not an enabled button.
At bottom of content, separate understated full-width outlined button with red exit icon and "Log out". A lot of quiet white space below; no invented settings, no profile identity, no version number, no large art. Bottom home indicator.
RIGHT screen:
small status bar 9:41 then back arrow and "Notifications".
First compact pale silver card: small bell icon, "Push notifications", disabled gray OFF switch; short two-line helper "Push alerts need the installed app." Small neutral "Unavailable on web" label. Accurately show that this is a web-preview state.
Section label "UPDATES". White bordered grouped rows, each 44–48px tall, small mint-backed icon and text, green ON switches except promotions OFF:
"Trip updates" ON
"Driver offers" ON
"Scheduled rides" ON
"Wallet and payments" ON
"Promotions and tips" OFF
Section label "ALERT OPTIONS". Two compact rows:
"Sound" ON
"Vibration" ON
Under the cards, a small shield icon and concise helper "Safety notices stay in your notification history."
Small green text action "Open notification history" with chevron, 44px hit area. Home indicator bottom.
Constraints: preserve all listed existing controls. Driver offers is shown as an approved-driver example; no claim of additional functionality. Main page and detail page visually consistent with a polished green and white ride app. No oversized fonts, no promotional banners, no gradients behind body text, no extra copy, no fabricated user data, no illustrations, no maps needed on settings, no watermarks. Render exact labels, no duplicates or typos.
